docs: Delivery zones content: the heading, a description and the zones, each with the area, the delivery time, the price and the minimum order as they are shown. One object is valid in every delivery layout (rows, cards).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

time.docs: the delivery time as it is shown; empty: none

price.docs: the delivery price as it is shown (free, 290 ₽)

minimum.docs: the minimum order as it is shown; empty: none
